title: Chore to use.
text:
Chore to use.. The grinder comes in multiple pieces so that it's easy to clean. It's handheld, so it's small, so expect to grind a lot to get the right amount that you need. I have to grind for about five minutes to get a couple cups' worth of coffee. The handle slips easily when trying to turn it without coffee in it, but shockingly I found that it didn't sleep once when I ground the coffee.

Just be aware that you will have to exert a lot of energy to grind. I developed a technique where I turn both the handle and the container at the same time to get a few more rotations in.
